name: Atlas
tagline: A personal knowledge base: collected references, generated from JSON into static pages.

topics.label: Azure with Terraform
topics.description: What an Azure service provides, what it needs, what it costs and how to build it with Terraform.

topics.label: GitOps
topics.description: GitOps principles, Argo CD in depth, Flux and other operators, and Helm, Kustomize and their alternatives.

topics.label: Identity providers
topics.description: Single sign-on and the protocols behind it (OIDC, SAML, LDAP, Kerberos, SCIM), open source identity providers, and how Argo CD and Kubernetes use one.

topics.label: Certificates
topics.description: X.509 and TLS basics, ACME and Let's Encrypt, private CAs, cert-manager and Kubernetes, and OpenSSL commands to inspect and troubleshoot.
